prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app UI design mockup, landscape 1536x1024, of the Social page in "Monochrome", a self-hosted music streaming app shared by a small circle of friends. This is a usable product interface, not a poster, not a photograph of a screen, not a marketing site. Dark theme. App shell: near-black #0a0a0a window with rounded 14px charcoal blocks separated by 8px gutters. Left sidebar block 210px wide: tiny logo of two overlapping squares plus "Monochrome" wordmark, nav items Music, Library, Social (selected, subtle highlight), Listening stats; a "Recents" label with three small pill chips Playlists, Albums, Artists; Upload and Settings at the bottom. Bottom player bar block 76px tall across the full width: small cover thumbnail of Currents by Tame Impala, "Let It Happen" / "Tame Impala", shuffle, previous, play, next, repeat, thin progress bar 1:48 / 7:47, volume slider. The main content block fills the rest and holds the Social page. Clean neutral sans (Inter-like) for UI text. Real content only, spelled exactly as given. SOCIAL PAGE, DIRECTION "THE BOOTH": the visual grammar of professional DJ deck displays (CDJ jog-wheel screens, waveform overviews, numeric readouts) translated into a social music page; matte anodized black hardware ground, inset backlit screen panels with thin bezels, condensed tabular numerals for readouts. Header row: "Social" title, small live line with a green dot "2 listening · 3 online", two quiet tabs Feed (active, underlined) and Messages with a small "2" badge. HERO "the room", full content width, about 380px tall, unboxed: a row of circular jog-wheel decks. Each deck is a circular album cover inside a dark platter with a thin progress ring in the cover's own color and a small white position marker line near the rim, slightly rotated as if spinning. Two large live decks in front: "Jon Bell" playing "Midnight City — M83" (cover: two children in blue haze) and "Luna" playing "Breathe Deeper — Tame Impala" (cover: orange-red retro desert room), each with a green live LED dot, a name plate, an LCD-style track readout and tabular time "2:41 / 4:03"; on the Luna deck show two small pill buttons "Listen along" and "Message" as if hovered. Behind and smaller, receding into darkness and progressively desaturated: "admin" Breathe Deeper "2 h ago", "suiveurtag" Picture in my mind — PinkPantheress "2 wk ago", "Mara Vale" "2 mo ago"; at the far edges tiny avatar-only discs for Noah, tester2, Inez Park. At the far left your own small deck "You" with an empty platter and "+ Share what you're playing". Each live deck casts a soft diffuse glow of its cover colors (blue, orange-red) onto the black ground. Below the hero: a slim post composer "What are you listening to?" with music and image icons and a "Post" button. Then the feed as a track log: section label "Your circle · 3 posts"; entries with a left gutter of small tabular time readouts, round avatar, bold author name and body text: Luna "This album hit different at 3AM" with an embedded album strip "Currents — Tame Impala · 2015" showing a long horizontal waveform overview tinted with the cover's purple and orange, a play button, heart 2, comments 2; Noah "the homelab FLAC upgrade is audible. no notes."; Jon Bell "Found a bassline that refuses to sit still." with a track waveform strip with white square brackets marking a 0:42–1:12 snippet. Color comes only from album art; UI chrome is black, charcoal and white. Premium hardware-UI finish, generous spacing, no glassmorphism, no neon overload, no grid of cards.
